result.title: TRCF: Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting for Irregular Multivariate Time Series
result.summary: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting supports healthcare monitoring, environmental analysis, and activity recognition. Channel-independent (CI) approaches capture each variable's temporal patterns but do not explicitly use observations from other variables. Channel-dependent (CD) modeling exploits relationships among variables, yet asynchronous measurements make these relationships difficult to learn. Incorporating cross-variable information while preserving each variable's irregular history therefore remains a key challenge. We propose Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting (TRCF), a framework that augments a compact CI forecaster with a complementary CD branch. ANCHOR aggregates observed values and timestamps at shared temporal locations, retaining observation support to form compact CI features. BRIDGE constructs complementary features through history completion. It first estimates each variable's historical values from its own observations, then uses differences between other variables' observed and estimated values at nearby times to correct missing entries. The completed history preserves observed values and is encoded to supply context alongside the direct CI representation. Finally, the two representations are fused, combined with the query-time embedding, and passed to a shallow multilayer perceptron for forecasting. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that TRCF achieves the lowest mean squared error and mean absolute error in the main benchmark comparison, while reducing measured peak inference memory by 17.28% to 87.98% relative to APN.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对不规则多变量时间序列预测，提出 TRCF：以紧凑的通道独立分支为基础，另设通道依赖分支，通过保留观测支撑的聚合与「估计—差值校正」的历史补全得到互补特征，再融合进行浅层 MLP 预测，并在四个真实数据集上报告了误差与推理显存优势。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「显式保留已观测值、另建估计补全的互补分支再融合」思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中如何避免视觉证据被隐状态坍缩、并区分直接观测表示与推断出的上下文；联系属跨领域启发，需人工判断可迁移性。
